title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode21 Wonderlands×Showtime

rows.Line: The last day of school break
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... I'm beat... I can't move a muscle!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...tired...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I suppose doing five shows in one day takes its toll! Even I have that leaden feeling in my limbs, despite my appearances being so brief.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But towards the end, we had so many spectators, there weren't enough seats! That's star power for you!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Huh, you think so? I overheard people saying that they came to our show because the park mascots and Robo-Nene made it seem like fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... Th-That certainly helped a bit, too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder if we've done enough to convince the management to keep this stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu's dad summoned her up to his office...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Guys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu! How did it go? What's going to happen to the stage?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wo...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Wo”?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yesss! That means we did it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm so happy! So the stage won't be demolished, after all...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, our efforts have paid off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you for all your help, guys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm happy for you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oof... That's a huge relief, but now I feel like I don't have an ounce of energy left...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We still need to tidy up, remember?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. It's a little sad but now that showtime's over, we need to clear up the stage decor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Say, Emu... What are your plans from now on?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since the stage will stay, your dad must be expecting you to keep using it, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I also want to keep making more and more people smile with lots of new shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you, Nene and Rui? What do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd like to keep performing and...aim to become a professional actress one day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I live for performances, so I too intend to carry on staging shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With actors such as you, I could create plays that redefine entertainment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, it seems we're all on the same page!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime shall continue operations!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I used to think that to become a star actor, you had to gain experience performing in major productions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But working on a show together with you reminded me that the best shows are ones that inspire joy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that to make them, you need a like-minded troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want to continue making shows together with you all. Here, on this stage we saved. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, yes, yesss!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa, easy there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I want the same as you!
Let's make lots and lots of shows together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm happy to continue too.
Maybe I could even perform on stage together with Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we're keeping this troupe going, I'll be able to get even more creative with my plays. Hehe, I can't wait to get started.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you're already doing a stellar job making us happy with your ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right? I AM a star after all!
Ha ha ha! Shower me with praise, I deserve it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're the brightest star in the galaxy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm? It might be just my imagination, but I could've sworn I heard someone laughing just now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I heard it too♪ It went like this, “Ha ha ha!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, it seems that someone's having a good time out there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, why don't we do a show?
We should be having a good time too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can't disagree with that, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's go KAITO! The stage is waiting♪
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone! Today we shall perform for you a show overflowing with the feelings which made this SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You will be transported to a wonderland full of smiles!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku & KAITO
rows.Line: It's showtime!
